title: unified-rollouts: probing staged shadow + AB autorollback enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Add staged shadow probing and improve AB/canary autorollback sensitivity and observability. This PR implements a probing policy for staged shadow deployments (staged-shadow-probe) that proactively sends small probe workloads to the candidate model variant and evaluates a configurable set of metrics before increasing shadow weight or promoting to a canary. Motivation: We observed flakiness after rolling out shadow variants where regressions only appeared under specific request patterns or sequences. Probing allows us to catch regressions deterministically using targeted probe sets before they affect live traffic or trigger noisy rollouts.

What changed: - New staged-shadow-probe policy in rollouts controller with configurable probe window, probe mix, and failure thresholds. - AB strategy adjustments: align metric matching window and traffic split ramping with probe results for more deterministic promotions/rollback. - Autorollback improvements: multi-metric matching (latency P95 + model score drift) with per-metric thresholds and a weighted decision function; automatic conservative fallback when probe coverage is low. - Observability: add rollout.probe.* metrics (probe_count, probe_failures, probe_latency_p95), enhanced tracing annotations for probe requests, and rollout decision logs to make rollback triggers auditable. - Testing: new unit and e2e tests that inject deterministic failures into shadow variants and verify that probes prevent unsafe promotions and that autorollback triggers when expected. - Docs: rollout config examples and operational runbook for staged-shadow-probe.

Implementation notes: - The probe engine runs as part of the rollouts controller and schedules probes at a low fixed QPS (configurable). Probes are constructed from a probe set that can be shared across customers; we added a minimal local probe set for tests/examples. - Probes are scored using existing model-output comparators (embedding distance and normalized logit deltas) and the existing metrics pipeline is reused to compute P95 latencies. - Autorollback is now calculated with a two-stage guard: (1) probe-based gating during initial shadowing, (2) metric-matching rollback during traffic ramp. Both guards are tunable via rollout policy.

Backward compatibility and migration: Default rollout behavior remains unchanged for clusters that do not opt into staged-shadow-probe. Rollout config schema version bump (v2) with migration code that interprets v1 configs as the conservative v2 defaults.

Testing and validation: - Unit tests for probe scheduler and decision logic. - Integration tests for AB/canary interactions with probe gating. - New e2e suite that runs in CI canary environment with deterministic failure injection; CI flakes observed once on first run and was rerun successfully.

References: Linear ENG-4821 and ENG-4890, incident SUP-1182 (customer regression uncovered during a shadow rollout), related PRs for rollouts observability and autorollback metrics.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] e2e tests - [x] Docs and runbook - [x] Metrics and tracing hooks

unified-rollouts: staged-shadow-probe + AB autorollback enhancements

Includes probe gating, multi-metric rollback, metrics, e2e tests, and docs.
release_notes: Add staged-shadow-probe policy to detect regressions with targeted probe workloads before promotion.
Improve AB/canary autorollback with multi-metric weighted decisions and conservative fallback when probe coverage is low.
Expose rollout.probe.* metrics and tracing annotations for better observability of probe-based decisions.
Rollout config schema bumped to v2; v1 configs are automatically interpreted with conservative defaults.
